description.p: CHOAB (Arabic: شعب, "the people") is a family of small, classic tools for everyday computer work. CHOAB Zip is the archiver: a two-pane archive manager written in pure Rust. Browse your files on the left and the contents of an archive on the right, without Wine, Qt or an external 7z process.

ul.li: Read and write 7z, zip, tar, tar.gz, tar.xz, tar.bz2 and tar.zst
Browse archive contents in-app, preview small text files
Open PDFs, media, images and office documents with the system app
Extract everything or only the selected item
Test archive integrity and inspect properties

description.p: Archives found inside another archive are extracted to a temporary folder and opened in a new choab-zip window; small text files and images still preview in place, everything else is handed to the desktop after extraction.
New app id (io.github.choab.Zip), a new executable name and icons at every standard size.

Monochrome. The interface is now strictly black, white and grey, with higher text and border contrast in both light and dark mode. The icon set was redrawn on a single stroke weight and the application icon is a new greyscale mark.

New interface. A single header bar, a flat icon-and-label command bar, a places sidebar, vector icons drawn at any scale, unified list columns with sort carets, an inspector-style viewer that never squeezes the archive pane, and centred dialogs. Colours follow the Plasma colour scheme and accent colour, with light and dark variants.

AES-256 encrypted 7z archives with interactive in-app password dialog, full compression control (levels 0-9, codecs LZMA2/ZSTD/BZIP2/Deflate/Brotli/LZ4/Copy, solid blocks, header encryption), pure-Rust CRC-32 and SHA-256 hash calculator, native in-app image viewer (PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF, WEBP), multi-item selection with batch extract and delete, interactive breadcrumb navigation, and Dark/Light theme switcher.

Text-only built-in viewer. PDFs, images, audio, video, office documents and other desktop file types now open with the system default application. Archive entries are extracted to a temporary copy first.
First packaged release: two-pane browser, 7z/zip/tar read+write, RAR reading, in-app viewer, 2026-style icon set.
